what: When a photo crosses the line 12% above the bottom of the screen, the not-yet-lit photos in the same row (within 200px of top offset) are grouped and faintly lit in sequence at .09s steps (max .45s) over 2s with cubic-bezier(.33,1,.68,1) — zigzag and grid covers appear to bloom row by row from the left. Photos already scrolled above the screen light up immediately. If a loader panel (html.is-fx-preload) is present, measuring waits until it clears

options.stagger: Stagger within the same row (sec), default .09
options.row: Vertical offset (px) for items grouped in the same row, default 200

note: Row group and sequence values are one per page, so the first element given the option sets the value for all
